headline: SCRIPT-FIRST CONTROL, MEDIA NEXT
summary: This week centered on BoxBrain execution efficiency and queue discipline: script-first routing was merged and verified, local/Git task queues were formalized, live rescue and WLAN gates were held safely at their dependency boundaries, and a GoPro Cloud virtual-drive/media-catalog experiment was added to the active queue. ArkmatX and the deployed realm builds remained stable rather than receiving new feature merges.

projects.name: ARKMATX
projects.detail: The rendered workshop/server/paradox build with independent hotspot layers, per-login state, scene navigation, raster-integrity guards, and five-viewport QA remains the current staging baseline. No new ArkmatX feature PR merged during Aug 3-9; GitHub status telemetry continued refreshing.

projects.name: BOXBRAIN
projects.detail: PR #10 merged deterministic Script/GPT/Hybrid routing, a versioned read-only script registry, structured execution results, idempotency and Cue/Complete duplicate prevention, routing metrics, and authenticated API endpoints. BB-006 passed 6 focused tests and the 97-test controller suite.

projects.name: AI WORKFLOWS
projects.detail: Script-first task offload is implemented and verified. The Multi-GPT Revolving Cycle and Microsoft Copilot Task Offload remain explicitly in Cue Hold as non-runnable design concepts pending routing, credential, usage-limit, and review rules.

projects.name: MEDIA STORAGE
projects.detail: A GoPro Cloud virtual-drive and media-catalog integration is now an active high-priority BoxBrain task, targeting metadata-first browsing, on-demand materialization, bounded local caching, deliberate SSD/HDD mirroring, and exact-duplicate hashing across GoPro Cloud, OneDrive, Google Drive, SSD, and HDD without automatic deletion.

projects.name: BRAIN CONNECT
projects.detail: The previously verified Raspberry Pi 4 controller, certificate boundary, bounded RDP input, and recovery evidence remain current. No new BrainConnect merge landed during Aug 3-9.

projects.name: WEBSITE CLUSTER
projects.detail: ClusterSites and the connected realm deployments remain in their prior verified state. No new ClusterSites deployment code merged during Aug 3-9.

projects.name: WET BEARD
projects.detail: The quest-card and rider systems remain live on the existing August build. No new Wet Beard feature merge landed during Aug 3-9.

projects.name: MORRI
projects.detail: The connected realm remains on its previously promoted production build; no new merge was recorded this week.

projects.name: WITCHDIX
projects.detail: The verified fallback deployment remains the current served build; no new merge was recorded this week.

projects.name: XANDER ZOMBIE
projects.detail: The previously promoted connected build remains current; no new merge was recorded this week.

weekly_log: Merged BoxBrain PR #10, completing BB-006 with deterministic Script/GPT/Hybrid routing, a versioned read-only script registry, structured results, idempotency, duplicate prevention, routing metrics, and authenticated processing endpoints.
Verified BB-006 with 6 focused script-first tests and 97 controller tests; three unrelated clean-main assertions remain outside the BB-006 change set.
Formalized the Codex queue workflow across Git and local Desktop copies with active Queue, Cue Hold, Cue Complete, bootstrap behavior, sync rules, and duplicate-work prevention.
Moved script-first offload from hold into active work and completed it, while keeping the Multi-GPT revolving cycle and Microsoft Copilot offload as intentionally non-runnable held concepts.

Advanced BB-001 Windows WLAN and BB-002 one-shot rescue work to verified checkpoints, then stopped safely: Morris PC was offline for live WLAN verification, and rescue deployment still requires legitimate media plus an authorized reboot window; BB-003 through BB-005 remain dependency-blocked.

Added BB-007 for a GoPro Cloud virtual-drive/media-catalog experiment using metadata-first inventory, on-demand downloads, cache controls, archive/mirror flows, and duplicate hashing without automatic deletion.

Kept ArkmatX and the deployed website cluster stable this week; wetbeard-site activity was limited to the prior weekly activity merge and repeated GitHub-status telemetry refreshes rather than new feature deployments.
easter_egg_seed: The queue learned to wait; somehow that made the machine faster.
